safeSameOwnerThicknessCandidates.basis: Each listed native mesh is rigid-parented to its own thigh/shin/foot assembly owner and declares exteriorEras maker,mechanic,builder. It can be thickened inward on that same owner while its evaluated end stations remain fixed.
safeSameOwnerThicknessCandidates.boundary: This is an ownership/end-station scope recommendation only. It does not establish clearance to guards, bearing pins, neighboring meshes, or dynamic pose envelopes. Keep pivot transforms and existing end-seat positions fixed; verify resulting surface clearance separately.
safeSameOwnerThicknessCandidates.notRecommendedForThickening: Bearing cores/races/pins and terminal joint/foot guards define bearing envelopes or articulated clearances; this extraction does not authorize changing their profiles.

limits: Native scene frame 1 is rest-state only; no browser pose, runtime pose packet, continuous motion, or swept clearance was sampled.
Endpoint projections and vertex distances do not prove watertight attachment, contact, penetration, collision freedom, load capacity, or physical validity.
